**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

Dear Madam
I am today sending your book to [Macmillans](../others.html#111) 29 and 30 Bedford Street, Covent Garden, and asking if they can give you one of my books to illustrate.

It might be a good plan for you to call there, tomorrow or next day.

Send up your card and ask for [Mr Craik](../persons.html#379) or [Mr Macmillan](../persons.html#939), mentioning my name.

If you cannot call, write, and say how the book shall be returned asking if they can give you a commission to do some illustrations.

After that I will write to [Marcus Ward](../others.html#236), who deals more in illustrations, and is going to publish the Bear and the Goblin in a book of poetry[^1]

yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: Francis Dawson, \'The Bear and the Goblin\' was included in CMY\'s anthology [Aunt Charlotte\'s Evenings at Home with the Poets](../books.html#143) (London: Marcus Ward 1881).

Perhaps it was one of the texts the unknown woman had illustrated.
